reports.title: PURSUIT REPORTS RECORD THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND REAFFIRMS FULL YEAR ADJUSTED EBITDA GUIDANCE MIDPOINT

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: “Based on continued demand for our authentic experiences and strong results year-to-date, we are reaffirming our full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA midpoint expectation of $133 million and narrowing our guidance range to $130 million to $136 million, from $128 million to $138 million, reinforcing our confidence in our ability to deliver,” said Barry.
Pursuit’s Adjusted EBITDA guidance midpoint of $133 million represents growth of approximately 14% year-over-year.
